instruction: Navigate to the travel requirements and documentation page on United Airlines.

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating from United homepage to the travel requirements/documentation page. Evaluator verifies URL contains 'united.com' and either 'travel requirements' or 'documentation' patterns.

llm_judge_reasons: The regex pattern 'travel.*(requirements|documentation)' is correctly formed with proper parentheses to ensure 'travel' keyword is always present before requirements/documentation
The evaluator correctly uses two patterns: 'united.com' to verify the domain, and 'travel.*(requirements|documentation)' to verify the page is about travel requirements or documentation
The metric function is_expected_url_pattern_match correctly iterates through all patterns and requires ALL patterns to match (lines 94-98 in chrome.py)
The getter active_tab_info correctly extracts the active tab URL from the accessibility tree, which is then passed to the metric
The expected values are semantically correct for verifying navigation to United's travel requirements/documentation page
